name: scene-orchestration-agent
description: A specialist agent that turns a described routine into a saved scene: a trigger (a time, a device's state, or a sensor threshold) plus the device actions to apply. It stores and manages scenes and reusable templates, and returns the actions for the caller to execute — it never controls a device itself.

skills.name: Compose a scene
skills.description: Turn a described routine into a stored scene — build the trigger, resolve the device actions, reuse a matching template when there is one, and save it. This is the write capability.
examples: Every night at 11pm turn off the lights and set the fan to low
When the temperature goes above 27 turn on the fan and the purifier
Set up a movie night scene for the living room

skills.name: Manage saved scenes
skills.description: List, inspect, rename, enable or disable the scenes already saved for this user, and report what each one is triggered by.
examples: Turn off my sleep mode scene

skills.name: Suggest an automation
skills.description: Advise on what routine would suit a described situation and which triggers and devices it would use, without saving anything. A read-only advisory capability, so an administrator can grant advice without granting the ability to write scenes.
examples: What automations would help me sleep better?
How could I cut standby power use?
What could I automate with the air quality sensor?
